items.claim: Amanda Lemos has fought a much higher level of competition compared to Alexa Grasso.
items.quote: Amanda Lemos who just fought Gillian Robertson, Tatiana Suarez, Jasmine Lucindo, Virna Jandiroba, Mackenzie Dern, Weili. I mean, this is the best. These are the best of the best. And Alexa Grasso has beaten Bruna Brasil, Luana Luque Boim, and Molly McCann.

items.claim: Amanda Lemos struggles against grapplers and does not fully put her takedown defense together.
items.quote: Amanda Lemos hasn't really been able to put it together against people who are trying to grapple her. She has okay takedown defense... but she never really puts it all together.

items.claim: Alexa Grasso fights like a bully.
items.quote: And Alexa Grasso is such a bully.

items.claim: Amanda Lemos has two submission losses on her record.
items.quote: Something to note about Amanda Lemosh as a pro, two submission losses
